title: How I’d Learn Solana Development in 2026 | Blockchain Developer Roadmap Series Introduction
description:
Want to become a Solana blockchain developer? In this video, I break  down a complete Solana developer roadmap for beginners, including the skills, tools, and technologies you need to learn to start building on Solana.                                                    
                                                                          
Whether you’re coming from web development, smart contract development, or completely new to blockchain, this roadmap will help you understand the fastest path to becoming a Solana developer.        
                                                                          
In this video, you’ll learn:                                           
   - What a Solana developer actually does                                
   - The core skills needed to build on Solana                            
   - What programming languages and tools to learn                        
   - How to approach smart contracts, frontend integration, and wallets   
   - A step-by-step learning path for becoming job-ready                  
   - How to start building real projects on Solana                        
                                                                          
This roadmap is designed for:                                          
   - Beginners interested in blockchain development                       
   - Developers moving from Web2 to Web3                                  
   - Anyone who wants to build dApps on Solana                            
   - Aspiring smart contract developers                                   
                                                                          
 Topics covered:                                                        
   Solana development, Solana roadmap, blockchain developer roadmap,      
   how to become a Solana developer, Solana smart contracts, web3         
   development, dApp development, Solana for beginners, Rust and          
   Solana, blockchain career path                                         
                                                                          
If you found this helpful, like the video, subscribe, and comment if you want more Solana tutorials, project walkthroughs, and smart  contract content.                                                      
                                                                          
#Solana #BlockchainDevelopment #Web3 #SolanaDeveloper                  
#SmartContracts #RustLang #dAppDevelopment #CryptoDev

asr.full_text: Hey everyone its Brii and in this series I'm going to go over a roadmap of how to become a Solana blockchain developer so lets go over at a high level what that's going to look like so you can start getting prepared first I'm going to start with setting up your environment on your computer for Solana development then we're going to learn how to leverage some useful tools on Solana to build and deploy an app on Chain in under 5 minutes Then we're going to go into understanding how to manage data onchain by creating a CRUDapp smart contract and then we're going to learn into how to manage data on Chain by creating a CRUD smart contract. And then we're going to learn how tokens work on Solana by understanding mint and token accounts and the different programs on Solana today! Then we're going to take that knowledge and apply it to creating a smart contract by creating an escrow program, which, honestly, at the end of the day, is basically an esco program. And then, after that, we are goingi products are escrow programs at a baseline. After that, we're going to update our escrow program to now use oracles. Oracles are how you can get real-time data feeds on-chain and also handle randomness on-chain. Then, once we have that completed, we're going to learn different ways to test your program, useful tools for developing on Solana, best practices for indexing. And after we complete all that, you should have all the knowledge you need to know to start building real products on Solana. So, check out the first video in this series which is setting up your Solana environment next.
